title: Local storage and faces
changes: Metadata for a local folder is stored in a SQLite file inside that folder, so notes and tags travel with the materials.
Folder scanning now reads subfolders, and materials are keyed by path so same-named files no longer collide.
Materials can be added from other folders and reattach on later visits.
Materials can be removed from a story and put back; the files on disk are never deleted.
Faces are drawn on top of photos, and selecting one shows every other material that person appears in.
A People strip below the search box filters the collection to one person.
Save failures are shown instead of being swallowed.
